A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] was the '''Padawan''' of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Usma]] during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Both [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were present on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when the Empire [[Sacking of Coruscant|attacked]] the world<ref name="Lord Praven" /> in [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Book of Sith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> and they fought the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] invaders.<ref name="Lord Praven" />

During the battle, Usma was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] [[Praven]], and the Sith decided to spare his enemy's apprentice before telling her to seek him out once she had completed her [[Jedi training/Legends|training]]. The apprentice survived the battle and completed her training as a Jedi, and she succeeded in tracking down her Master's killer years later during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that followed the Great War. True to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] word, he agreed to [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] the young Jedi, and she was cut down by the far more experienced Sith.<ref name="Lord Praven" />

==Behind the scenes==
Usma's Padawan was first mentioned in a codex entry in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Lord Praven" />
